governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with referral to relevant Digital and IT product, architecture, data, assurance and service governance where formal authority is required.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the Student Experience Hub product direction; the outcomes and evidence required from the 2026/27 discovery-led mobilisation year; the focused September 2027 first live release; the common home and shared app foundations; the access pattern used for King’s Edge, timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s; any proposal to deepen a non-Edge integration where this would create material new effort; sequencing; platform investment and operating costs; readiness for the first live release; the evidence used to select later end-to-end journeys; and enduring product and service ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – enduring Student Experience Hub product and service owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: An interim accountable product and service ownership model must be clear for the September 2027 first live release. The enduring ownership model can then be settled using evidence from delivery and live use as the Hub moves into deeper cross-service journeys. It should distinguish accountable Hub product and platform ownership under 4.1.2 from the multidisciplinary team and product practices established through 4.1.3, and clarify ownership of source-system access, student-facing content and later cross-service journeys.
